title: Topic register
description: Meta-schema for topics.yaml. Validates the register's shape; the convention regex inside the register validates the topic names themselves.

consumers.description: May be empty. An empty list is a deliberate 'no consumer today' state and the register says so in the topic's summary.

carries.description: 'envelope' - the message is an EventEnvelope and the registered schema constrains its open metrics/payload pair. 'raw' - the message is a bare JSON object and the registered schema constrains the whole of it. The distinction is real: the dead-letter topic exists to preserve messages that failed the envelope contract, so it cannot itself be carried in one.

event_schema.description: Path, relative to this file's directory, of the JSON Schema for this topic's event body.
